notes: Fishing catch (prototype adaptation, 2026-11-17). Book: no fishing rule; Security covers survival (Core p.92); Fitness is physical prowess (p.89); focuses Survival / Animal Handling / Athletics appear in lifepath lists. Prototype: Fitness + Security, Difficulty = the spot's authored difficulty.
Passive window: splashSecondsFor scales by fishing skill (Fitness + Security) around referenceSkill, like sneak.json. First-pass tuning.

Roll: when the splash starts the angler rolls the task (2d20, no bought dice). Success lengthens the Catch window further and can save Momentum; failure keeps the skill-scaled window. The player still clicks Catch (or presses A).
Equipment: a fishing rod is already required to start (canStartFishing). The splash roll does not re-check inventory (prepareTask only sees equipped items, and the rod lives in the bag).
